notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) only - direct HTTP fetch (curl, browser UA) of shoppersstop.com/category/Homestop and its Next.js pages; robots.txt allows ClaudeBot/Claude-User/claude-web with Allow: / (only /cart, /checkout, /account, /search, /api etc disallowed, none of which were touched), no block encountered so Playwright/Chrome were not needed. SCOPE: HomeStop is Shoppers Stop's home-goods vertical, reached from /category/Homestop; its own CMS page (getClpInfo query in __NEXT_DATA__) lists 9 L2 sections: Bedding(/home-bedding/c-1117), Living(/home-living/c-1120), Dining(/home-dining/c-1284), Kitchen(/home-kitchen/c-1372), Bath & Laundry(/home-bath-laundry/c-1419), Home & Kitchen Appliances(/home-home-kitchen-appliances/c-1451), Decor(/home-decor/c-1474), Pet Care(/home-pet-care/c-2592, 0 live products), Music Collections(/home-music-collections/c-2613, 1 K-pop album product) - only these 9 were treated as in-scope HomeStop nodes; the site's general Men/Women/Kids/Watches/Brands/Gifts apparel-fashion catalog was never opened. TREE: built by reading each L2 page's embedded __NEXT_DATA__ (React Query dehydratedState -> 'Browse_Categories' query, an Unbxd search-facet payload) which returns categoryPath3_uFilter (L3 names+counts) and by grepping the same HTML for /home-<slug>/c-<id> anchor hrefs to discover L4 children, then fetching each L4 (and childless-L3) page directly for its own exact count and to re-confirm the categoryPath facet name matched the requested node (used as the h1/canonical-equivalent check since these subpages carry a generic fallback <title>). Home & Kitchen Appliances(38 products, all appliances), Decor's Fragrance/Vases/Garden/Idols/Lamps L3s, Pet Care and Music Collections were confirmed out of scope (checked Wall Accents=7 and Decor Accents=9 individually - both are decorative wall art/tabletop objects, no textile or storage items, excluded) and not itemized further. QTY: each recorded leaf's qty is the site's own numberOfProducts from that leaf's Browse_Categories response (equivalent to the rendered 'N products' count); parent L3 totals were NOT recorded when valid L4 children exist (per parent-URL rule), even where L4 children summed to less than the parent total (e.g. Bed Sheets L3=1432 vs its 4 children summing to 1400, Quilts/Comforters/Dohars L3=450 vs children summing to 369) - those un-tagged residual units live only at the parent level and were dropped rather than guessed at; several nodes matched exactly (Table Linens 58=47+11, Table & Kitchen Linens 20=2+15+3+0, Towels 391=2+179+153+57, Laundry 33=25+8) confirming the method. EXCLUDED (checked, out of scope): Dining Table Cover (Living L3 facet reported qty=5 but /home-living-dining-table-cover/c-1278 returns a genuine 404 with no Browse_Categories data at all - no verifiable listing page exists, dropped rather than fabricate a link); Diwan Sets (c-1192), Chair Cover (c-1275), Chair Pads (c-1271), Kitchen Aprons & Gloves (c-1411) - each returns a soft-404 (title 'Not Found | Shoppers Stop') with numberOfProducts=0 in its own Browse_Categories payload, i.e. dead/inactive nav links with no live products, dropped as no-longer-valid categories rather than emitted as zero-qty rows; Bath Sets (73, product-title-checked: polyresin soap dish/tumbler/bathroom accessory sets, not textile); Casseroles (38, product-title-checked: stainless-steel/nonstick cooking casseroles and biryani handis - cookware despite living under the 'Storage Solution' L3 label, not genuine storage); Table Tops > Baskets (13, product-title-checked: bamboo trays/mug trees/utensil racks/dish racks - kitchen serveware, neither textile nor storage); all of Dining except Table Linens (Tea & Coffee/Drinkware/Dinnerware/Cutlery/Serveware/Table Tops - Kitchen & Dining tableware); Kitchen's Cookware & Bakeware and Food Preps & Tools; Ottomans (Furniture, no dedicated category page found - product-level only); Yoga Mats (fitness product, not home textile); all Home & Kitchen Appliances, Pet Care, Music Collections. Lunch Boxes & Bags (18, product-titled Lunch Box/Tiffin Box Container/Lunch Bag) included in Storage at MEDIUM confidence - primarily food-storage containers (tiffin boxes) rather than personal-carrying fashion bags, but a couple of 'Lunch Bag' SKUs sit close to that boundary. No blocks encountered; status=ok.
